note: Public-source snapshot. The 2026 regular season is complete. Team standings metrics are from the official UPSHOT standings page; player snapshots remain date-stamped because rosters changed during the season.

championship.format: Top two regular-season teams · winner-take-all inaugural championship

teams.note: The regular-season pace setter. Jacksonville finished first, paired the league's best defensive scoring mark with 25 wins, and earned the right to play the inaugural title game on its home floor.
Charlotte hit the championship runway hot: a four-game winning streak, a 9-1 finish over the last ten, the league's best scoring average and the best point differential in the final table.

teams.arena: Novant Health Fieldhouse / First Horizon Coliseum
teams.note: Greensboro finished third in year one. The Groove's inaugural season included statement wins and a roster that produced one of the league's first WNBA call-ups in Christyn Williams.
Savannah closed the regular season with a 92-90 win over first-place Jacksonville, a fitting reminder that the final table did not tell the whole story of the Steel's fight in year one.

timeline.title: The league is announced
timeline.detail: Zawyer Sports & Entertainment announces a new professional women's basketball league headquartered in Jacksonville, with play targeted for May 2026.

timeline.title: The Founding Four get identities
timeline.detail: Savannah Steel, Jacksonville Waves, Charlotte Crown and Greensboro Groove are unveiled as the inaugural clubs.

timeline.title: Opening tip
timeline.detail: UPSHOT's first regular-season games are played: Savannah at Greensboro and Charlotte at Jacksonville.

timeline.title: First WNBA call-up
timeline.detail: Charlotte Crown forward Michelle Onyiah becomes the first UPSHOT player to earn a WNBA contract.

timeline.title: A second door opens
timeline.detail: Greensboro guard Christyn Williams signs with the Dallas Wings, becoming the second inaugural-season UPSHOT-to-WNBA move.

timeline.title: Regular season complete
timeline.detail: Jacksonville finishes first at 25-9, Charlotte second at 23-11, and the championship field is set.

timeline.title: The first championship
timeline.detail: Jacksonville and Charlotte meet at VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena for the league's inaugural title.
